title: copilot tools / Prerequisites
content: ## Prerequisites * The current public [Foundry Toolkit extension and its prerequisites](/docs/intelligentapps/overview.md#install-and-setup). * Access to [{% data variables.product.prodname_copilot %} Chat in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %}](/docs/setup/copilot.md). * A folder open for the agent project. Use a separate project folder rather than an unrelated application's workspace. * Access to a [selected Foundry project](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/how-to/develop/set-up-foundry-project-visual-studio-code). You can choose a model during the walkthrough, but need a compatible [model deployment](/docs/intelligentapps/models.md#deploy-a-model-to-microsoft-foundry) before testing inference. * Python and the dependencies required by the generated project. Follow its setup instructions and review the [hosted-agent prerequisites](/docs/intelligentapps/hosted-agents.md#prerequisites) before running or deploying it. Remote model requests can consume quota or incur charges even when the agent runs locally. Use non-sensitive test inputs and keep credentials out of prompts and committed files.
